name: Report to Ironforge

intro: This errand sends an adventurer from Thelsamar in Loch Modan into the heart of Ironforge with critical updates from Ironband's Excavation Site. Delivering the excavation progress report to Prospector Stormpike in the Assembly of Explorers sets off an investigation into missing blastpowder and stalled archaeology in the foothills.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We'll need approval to get Ironband more blastpowder. You'll have to take his report to the Explorers' League headquarters in Ironforge.
Here's the report. Give it to Prospector Stormpike, and don't forget to duck after you deliver it. Stormpike is hotheaded, and he won't be happy to hear of Ironband's slow progress at the site.
You'll find Stormpike in the Assembly of Explorers.

clips.title: Progress
paras: We Stormpikes don't like being bothered with trivial matters, adventurer. I hope you brought news worthy of my valuable attention.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Curse that Ironband! I sent him a load of blastpowder weeks ago, but he's made no mention of it in this report.
